name: Signal Filter Expansion Inventory
summary: Declarative refinements for filter design, validation, application, and frequency-response analysis pipelines.

operations.name: Analyze Pole Stability
operations.intent: Check filter stability from pole locations immediately after filter design.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a stability check after designing the filter.

rewrite.before_summary: Filter design feeds the next filter stage directly.
rewrite.after_summary: A pole-stability analysis stage is inserted after filter design.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds explicit stability evidence before the filter is trusted.

operations.name: Measure Passband Ripple
operations.intent: Quantify passband distortion after stability validation.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a passband ripple measurement after validating stability.

rewrite.before_summary: Stability validation feeds downstream filter stages directly.
rewrite.after_summary: A passband-ripple measurement stage is inserted after validation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds amplitude-distortion evidence for the passband.

operations.name: Analyze Group Delay
operations.intent: Expose phase distortion from group-delay variation after frequency-response analysis.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a group-delay check after computing the frequency response.

rewrite.before_summary: Frequency-response analysis feeds the downstream result directly.
rewrite.after_summary: A group-delay analysis stage is inserted after frequency-response analysis.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds phase-distortion evidence for the filter.

operations.name: Detect Transient Response
operations.intent: Identify startup artifacts after applying a filter to a signal.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a transient-artifact check after applying the filter.

rewrite.before_summary: The applied filter output feeds downstream stages directly.
rewrite.after_summary: A transient-response detection stage is inserted after filter application.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds startup-artifact evidence for the filtered signal.

audit.rationale: Externalizes implemented signal filter expansion operations into provider-owned declarative assets.
audit.dejargonized_summary: These are checks that make filter pipelines more explicit when stability, passband ripple, phase delay, or startup artifacts may be a problem.

references.title: Matcher signal_filter expansion rules
references.note: Rule names and trigger metrics mirror sciona/principal/expansion_rules/signal_filter.py.
